# Vendored Native Converter

This directory vendors the `svg_to_pptx` native SVG-to-PPTX converter from the
`ppt-master` skill implementation.

The implementation is used under the MIT License. It is bundled here so
`codex-bento-ppt` can create native editable PowerPoint decks without requiring
a separate `ppt-master` skill installation at runtime.

Local source used for this vendor import:

```text
/home/fecyj/.agents/skills/ppt-master/scripts/svg_to_pptx
```
